page.heroLine: Head of Strategy at blut. Campaigns, content and activations with music at their heart.
intro: Karl Jawara is Head of Strategy at blut, the music-led creative agency in Hamburg.
He shapes how a brand’s sound comes to life in the world: campaigns and content, artist collaborations and cultural activations, all starting from the brand’s sonic DNA and measured for their impact.

expertise.heading: Campaigns & Creative Product
expertise.intro: Informed by blut’s analytical insights, Karl’s work turns a sonic identity into assets and experiences across every touchpoint:

items.name: Content & Campaign Production
items.text: Campaigns, social content, films and brand experiences that don’t just grab attention, they earn emotional loyalty. Every piece starts with the brand’s sonic DNA and turns it into real-world resonance.

items.name: Artist Partnerships
items.text: Artist collaborations that are creatively inspired and make strategic sense, like DJ Seinfeld and sogumm for the Hyundai Inster launch, or UK Grime artist Che Lingo for the VW e-up!

items.name: Cultural Activation & Experiences
items.text: Branded playlists, cultural partnerships and live experiences that make a brand part of the conversation, not an outsider shouting from the sidelines.

items.name: Measurable Impact
items.text: Engagement, cultural resonance and strategic impact tracked with the Sonic Performance Tracker, so every campaign shows how its sound is being heard and felt.

faq.name: What is a music-led campaign?
faq.text: A campaign built around the brand’s sound: a song, an artist partnership or a sonic identity that carries the films, social content and live moments, instead of music added at the end.

faq.name: Can blut connect brands with artists?
faq.text: Yes. blut matches brands with artists using data-based research and qualitative factors, so the partnership feels authentic and makes strategic sense. Recent examples include DJ Seinfeld and sogumm for Hyundai.

faq.name: How does blut measure a campaign’s impact?
faq.text: With reporting, market research and data analytics, including the Sonic Performance Tracker: direct response, cultural resonance and strategic impact scoring.

faq.name: How do I start a campaign with blut?
faq.text: Write to Karl at karl.jawara@blut.agency. blut is based in Hamburg with offices in Berlin and Munich.

page.heroLine: Head of Audio Production at blut. Music, sound design and the final mix, from the first idea to the finished spot.
intro: Michael Robb is Head of Audio Production at blut, the music-led creative agency in Hamburg.

He leads how a brand’s sonic strategy turns into sound people actually hear: brand songs and original scores, remakes of songs everyone knows, sound design that carries a spot, and the final mix that ties it together.

expertise.heading: Audio Production
expertise.line: From the first note to the final mix.
expertise.intro: Every piece of audio starts with the brand’s sonic DNA. These are the parts of a production Michael’s team takes on, alone or together:

items.name: Music Production & Brand Songs
items.text: Original music written for a brand: for the Schwarzkopf relaunch, a brand song with changing arrangements for a range of celebrities and influencers; for Adidas Superstar, a film score from yesteryear with brass, woodwinds and grand piano.

items.name: Sound Design
items.text: Sound that carries the picture, from adventurous to subtle to insane: for Gore-Tex, recordings of their all-weather testing machines in a secret lab in the Bavarian Alps, turned into an adventure in sound design.

items.name: Remakes & Licensing
items.text: Songs everyone knows, made new: a Backstreet Boys classic for McDonald’s and Michael Sembello’s Maniac for Targobank, from licensing to recreating the original sound to casting the right voice.

items.name: Mixing & Final Mix
items.text: The last step that makes a spot sound finished: for Samsung with Nina Chuba, her voice recordings from the film set, a soundtrack for the visuals, subtle SFX for the movement and an overall natural yet hi-end mix.

faq.name: What does blut’s audio production include?
faq.text: Music production and brand songs, sound design, remakes and licensing of existing songs, casting singers and voices, and the final mix for film, social and campaign assets.

faq.name: Can blut remake a well-known song for a campaign?
faq.text: Yes. For McDonald’s blut remade a Backstreet Boys classic, and for Targobank Michael Sembello’s Maniac, covering licensing, recreating the sound and casting.

faq.name: Does blut only do music, or sound design too?
faq.text: Both. Some spots need a song; others are carried by sound design, like the Gore-Tex campaign built from recordings of their testing machines, or the Crazy Wolf energy-drink spot.

faq.name: How do I start an audio production with blut?
faq.text: Write to Michael at michael.robb@blut.agency or call +49 177 6233941. blut is based in Hamburg with offices in Berlin and Munich.
